blocks.text: Photosynthesis mein roshni bohat aham hai: yeh woh tawanai deti hai jis se chemical reactions chalte hain aur saada molecules pecheeda (complex) organic compounds ban jate hain. Roshni ki tawanai chlorophyll jazb karta hai. Yeh jazb hui tawanai chemical tawanai mein badalti hai aur organic compounds mein C-H bonds ki tawanai ki shakal mein jama ho jati hai. (Kitab yahan “It happens like this;” likhti hai magar aage koi khaaka nahin chhapti.)

blocks.title: Sirf 1-2%
blocks.text: Poday apne upar parne wali sooraj ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% chemical tawanai mein badalte hain. Yeh kam lagta hai, lekin zameen ki taqreeban tamam zindagi ke liye kaafi hai.

Photosynthetic pigments roshni ki mukhtalif wavelengths (rangon) ko mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain, aur har wavelength photosynthesis mein barabar asar-daar bhi nahin hoti. Har wavelength kitni asar-daar hai, yeh action spectrum se maloom hota hai. Action spectrum ke liye poday par baari baari mukhtalif rangon ki roshni dali jati hai, aur har rang par patton se nikalne wali oxygen naap kar photosynthesis ki raftar maloom ki jati hai. Is data ka graph action spectrum kehlata hai. Pehla action spectrum German biologist T. W. Engelmann ne 1883 mein banaya. Unhon ne Spirogyra (ek alga) ke pigments par kaam kiya: Spirogyra ke filament par mukhtalif wavelengths ki roshni dalne se sab se zyada photosynthesis, aur sab se zyada oxygen, un cells mein hui jin par neeli (blue) aur surkh (red) roshni padi.
